programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S53/E2 - More Cheese, Please!'. The chefs find cheese in every basket and have to make it the star of every plate. A wild comfort food hybrid proves challenging in round two.

programme.desc: 'S26/E4 - Kitchen Goals'. The hosts take on viral trends and make recipes like the Monte Cristo breakfast sandwich, granola cookies and waffle cereal. There's also a twist on bread-baking.

programme.desc: 'S48/E8 - Battle Of The Meats: Beef'. Four chefs battle it out with bovine-centric ingredients. More than one of the competitors decide to show off their raw talent by serving uncooked meat.

programme.desc: 'S36/E5 - Winners' Whammy Auction'. Guy Fieri welcomes four previous winners back for a non-stop super battle, starting with a dreaded whammy auction.
